survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance Python web framework built on top of Starlette. It provides a declarative API for building HTTP and WebSocket applications with automatic request validation, dependency injection, and OpenAPI documentation generation. The framework combines Starlette's ASGI foundation with Pydantic for data validation and automatic documentation, enabling developers to write type-annotated route handlers that are automatically validated and documented.

conventions: Type annotations are mandatory: function parameters must be type-annotated; FastAPI uses type hints to drive validation and documentation.
Param descriptors control how parameters are sourced: Path/Query/Header/Cookie/Body/Form/File annotations on function arguments determine where values come from in the HTTP request.
Depends() marks nested dependencies: function parameters annotated with Depends(callable) trigger recursive dependency resolution; solve_dependencies executes this tree at request time.
Security schemes via SecurityBase: custom authentication is defined by subclassing SecurityBase and registering instances via Security() or Depends() annotations.
Pydantic models for request/response: request bodies and response schemas are defined as Pydantic BaseModel subclasses; FastAPI automatically validates and serializes them.
Decorators are stacked: route registration uses Python decorators (app.get(), app.post(), etc.) that ultimately call APIRouter.add_api_route().
OpenAPI generation is automatic: registered routes are introspected at schema generation time; no manual documentation required (though it can be customized).
Async-first design: handlers and dependencies should be async functions whenever possible; solve_dependencies detects and awaits coroutines.

survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework built on top of Starlette that provides high-level abstractions for building REST APIs and WebSocket applications. It uses Pydantic for data validation and OpenAPI schema generation. The core architecture consists of (1) the FastAPI application class which extends Starlette and acts as the entry point, (2) the routing layer (APIRouter and APIRoute) that maps HTTP/WebSocket requests to endpoint handlers, (3) a dependency injection system that automatically extracts, validates, and injects request parameters and custom dependencies into endpoint functions, (4) request handlers that orchestrate dependency resolution, parameter extraction, endpoint execution, and response serialization, and (5) comprehensive exception handling and OpenAPI documentation generation.

conventions: Path operations are defined using HTTP method decorators (get, post, put, delete, patch, options, head, trace) on FastAPI instances or APIRouter instances, with the endpoint function's type annotations driving request/response validation and OpenAPI schema generation

survey.architecture: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs with automatic documentation. Built on Starlette as its HTTP layer, it adds automatic request/response validation via Pydantic, dependency injection, and OpenAPI schema generation. The core pattern: applications define path operations (via FastAPI or APIRouter), each operation is parsed into a Dependant model describing its parameters and dependencies, requests are matched to routes, dependencies are solved (injected values resolved), the endpoint function is called, and responses are validated and serialized. FastAPI bridges high-level handler logic with low-level ASGI protocol handling.
